response.justification: Despite extensive software experience, the candidate lacks direct C++ development experience in industrial automation, high-performance systems, or secure engineering per IEC 62443 — core requirements for this role. Their work is primarily in TypeScript, Node.js, DLang, and web stacks, with only a brief, non-detailed mention of C++ at National Instruments over a decade ago, insufficient to meet the senior C++ architect expectations.
strengths: Strong full-stack and cross-platform development experience across diverse domains.
Demonstrated leadership in open-source projects and technical mentoring.
Proven ability to build scalable, event-driven systems and contribute to DevOps infrastructure.
concerns: No recent or substantial C++ production experience in performance-critical or embedded systems.
Lacks demonstrable expertise in industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443) or MQTT/Modbus protocols.
No evidence of multi-threaded, networked C++ system design or STL-based architecture work.
